title: Chapter 73
text:
Han Xiao looked at the red-haired woman and did not dodge.

The dagger stopped three centimeters away from the aorta. The sudden change in movement showed that the red-haired woman had great control over her body. "Why aren't you dodging?"

"Why should I?"

"You think I don't dare to stab you?"

"You can give it a try."

Han Xiao's expression was normal. Under the red-haired woman's sight, the magnetically-controlled retractable armor had climbed up to his collar and could protect his neck at any time. Therefore, he was not afraid of the dagger.

Furthermore, the fact that the other party was able to appear in the military camp so openly meant that they were Hesla's agents. Therefore, it was impossible for them to actually attack him. This was most likely a test or a show of strength. Since they had chosen him as their target, Han Xiao was slightly displeased. Even his gaze became oppressive.

The red-haired woman suddenly felt a chill down her spine. She did not know where this feeling came from. She calmed herself down and said coldly, "Winna, MIB agent."

As soon as she finished speaking, Winna suddenly felt something poking her lower abdomen. She looked down and saw a large caliber pistol pointing at her abdomen.

Han Xiao smiled and said, "Han Xiao."

So fast! I did not even see how he pulled out the gun!

Winna's pupils shrank. She put away her dagger. Han Xiao also put away his gun.

"I will remember your name."

Winna turned around and left.

Han Xiao shook his head. "Hesla agents are indeed not friendly. I hope they will not drag me down …"

…

After walking for a distance, Winna heaved a sigh of relief. Then, she realized that cold sweat was dripping down her temples. Her expression was slightly serious.

That Stardragon agent gave her a very dangerous feeling!

When Winna returned to the Hesla agent's lounge, Ye Fan smiled and asked, "What did you find?"

Winna drank a mouthful of water to moisten her dry throat. She said in a deep voice, "That Han Xiao is not someone to be trifled with."

"Han Xiao?"

Ye Fan recalled from the description of his appearance.

That guy had been very low-key ever since he got off the bus. It seemed that he only had a weird expression when he heard my name.

"A weird person," Ye Fan concluded.

…

After Han Xiao finished smoking, he stepped on the cigarette butt and walked back to the lounge.

Qi Bai Jia looked over and suddenly asked, "Did anything happen?"

"Yes, I just saw a sow fall into the ditch."

Qi Bai Jia was embarrassed. "Can you be more serious?"

"Then it's fine." Han Xiao dug his ears. Since it was just a test, he didn't want everyone to know about it. Firstly, it was for the sake of the mission. Secondly, he felt that there was no need to let his emotions affect his decisions.

In his mind, there were three types of enemies. The first type were those who were motivated by personal feelings or had infringed on his interests. The second type were those who wanted to kill him and threatened his life. The third type were mortal enemies. Not only did they have hatred, but they also had conflicts of interests. The Germinal Organization was such a case. Facing the Germinal Organization, the enemy with the highest priority, personal feelings had to wait in the waiting list.

Qi Bai Jia looked at Han Xiao deeply. His seat was near the window, so he could see the door. He had seen everything that happened just now. He had experienced many missions and knew that the agents of other countries would definitely test and show off their strength. This was almost an unspoken rule. The agents were all proud and arrogant. If they didn't show their strength, they wouldn't have the right to speak. If they complained to their superiors, they would be laughed at.

Qi Bai Jia had a look of approval in his eyes. He was very satisfied with Han Xiao's performance just now. He did not lose his prestige, and he was very happy that Han Xiao kept the secret. He thought to himself, This guy's strength and ability to see the big picture are both very good.

…

"They didn't fight?"

After listening to the report from the adjutant, Carl nodded with satisfaction.

"Very good. It seems that the Stardragon people know whose territory this is."

…

Soon, it was time to depart. Everyone arrived at the border exit. Ye Fan, Winna, and more than ten agents were ready to go.

The first stop of the mission was a location very far away from Crow Forest Town. There was an unused secret base of Hesla there that would be used as a temporary base.

The vehicles assigned to Division 13 were sent by train. They were all normal off-road vehicles. Only Han Xiao's Da Hei was different. It carried his teammates and set off with a rumble.

This time, he drove steadily. Li Ya Lin was so touched that she was about to cry. The other three teammates squeezed in the driver's seat were confused. They couldn't understand why Li Ya Lin looked like she had just survived a disaster.

The journey took about half a day. Hesla's fleet led the way in front, and Division 13 followed behind.

Suddenly, Hesla's fleet accelerated and gradually increased the distance between them. Seeing this, Di Su Su and Ma Qing Yang also sped up to catch up.

Only Han Xiao drove Da Hei and followed behind at a leisurely pace.

"Brother Xiao, let's hurry up and catch up!" Lin Yao said hurriedly.

Han Xiao held the steering wheel with one hand and put the other hand outside the window. He said casually, "What's there to chase? No matter how fast they run, they will still have to slow down and wait for me."

"That's right …"

Di Su Su's laughter could be heard over the radio. "Little Lin Lin, where are you? Hurry up and catch up. Could it be that Brother Han Xiao's driving skills are not good enough?"

"It's a waste of gas," Han Xiao said concisely.

Di Su Su was stunned. It was the first time she had heard such a refreshing excuse. Why would agents care about gas?

Ma Qing Yang said over the radio, "Old Zhang, this is Hesla's demonstration. We can't back down!"

Zhang Wei thought for a few seconds and patted Han Xiao's shoulder. "Let's catch up."

Li Ya Lin's face turned pale. She grabbed Zhang Wei's sleeve and said, "Don't, Captain! It's good to maintain this speed!"

"What are you afraid of?" Zhang Wei was confused.

"Captain, isn't it good to be alive?" Li Ya Lin said with a trembling voice.

Zhang Wei was confused. He couldn't make head or tail of it.

"Really?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

"Really." Zhang Wei nodded.

Han Xiao sighed and changed gears skillfully. "Sit tight then."

Li Ya Lin was terrified. She gripped the handle of the car tightly. Her teeth were chattering.

"You … you'll regret this."

…

In the afternoon, they arrived at their destination.

After everyone got out of the car, they looked at the black truck in front of them with a mixture of fear, astonishment, and disbelief. They shuddered as they recalled the scene just now.

As experienced agents, they had seen "S" and "Z" movements. However, this was the first time they had seen "&" movements! Furthermore, they were running faster than anyone else!

This was not drifting! This was f * cking taking off!

The driver of the heavy truck was drunk!

Zhang Wei, Lin Yao, and Li Ya Lin stumbled out of the car and held onto a nearby tree. They vomited so much that the sky turned dark. They wished they could go back to the furnace and start anew.

"Retch …"

"I … I feel like I'm going to die. Retch …"

"I told you you'd regret this. Retch …"

Han Xiao got out of the car with a cigarette in his mouth. "You were the ones who wanted me to chase."

"You … you used to drive bumper cars?!"

Han Xiao curled his lips. Bumper cars? You're looking down on me. I used to drive mechas!

Lambert got out of the car with steady steps. Han Xiao's eyes lit up. "See, there's still a normal person."

Lambert wanted to say something to Han Xiao. However, as soon as he opened his mouth, vomit poured out like a waterfall. When it was all gone, Lambert said expressionlessly,

"If you touch the steering wheel again, I'll jump out of the car."
